projects.title: EventSync — Multi-Tenant Event Management SaaS
bullets: Built a full-stack multi-tenant event management SaaS with organization workspaces, Clerk authentication/organizations, and role-based access control (RBAC) enforced at the API layer with strict workspace-level data isolation.
Synced user and organization lifecycle events via Svix-backed Clerk Webhooks into NeonDB using Prisma ORM, with soft deletes and versioned migrations for safe schema evolution.

Implemented per-tenant rate limiting with Upstash Redis, Zod-validated environment config, and structured logging to harden the app for serverless deployment, and built an admin dashboard to audit webhook events.
Wrote Vitest unit/integration tests and Playwright E2E tests covering RBAC and tenant isolation, wired into a GitHub Actions CI pipeline.

projects.title: AskAway — Full-Stack QnA Platform
bullets: Built a Stack Overflow-style developer-focused QnA platform enabling real-time question browsing and answers; leveraged Next.js SSR to achieve sub-2s page load across 10+ dynamic routes.
Architected real-time answer sync using Appwrite Webhooks, with the Appwrite SDK handling authentication, user management, and database operations.
Resolved server-side auth hydration mismatch in Next.js App Router by configuring Appwrite session cookies for SSR, ensuring consistent authentication state across server and client renders.
Designed a fully responsive, mobile-first UI with React.js and Tailwind CSS, ensuring consistent UX across devices.
